components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; min-height: 68px; padding: 0 24px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg, #f4f2ee) 86%, transparent); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, rgb(22 24 29 / 0.1)); font-family: var(--sans, 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-nav__mono { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--btn, #16181d); color: var(--on-btn, #fff); font: 650 1rem var(--serif, 'Source Serif 4 Variable', Georgia, serif); margin-right: auto; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav__links a { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #16181d); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms; } .ds-nav__links a:hover { background: var(--card, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(22 24 29 / 0.06); } .ds-nav__links a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2b45d4); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-icon-btn { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgb(22 24 29 / 0.1)); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--ink, #16181d); } .ds-icon-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-icon-btn--pending { border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--rule-strong, rgb(22 24 29 / 0.22)); color: var(--ink-3, #646a78); cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-icon-btn--pending::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -4px; right: -4px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, #ffe81a 0 3px, #121212 3px 5px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px var(--card, #fff); }

components.css: .ds-scene { position: relative; height: 260px; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--card, #fff); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgb(22 24 29 / 0.05), 0 28px 64px -28px rgb(22 24 29 / 0.3); overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--sans, 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-scene__bar { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 8px 0 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, rgb(22 24 29 / 0.1)); background: var(--card-2, #f8f7f4); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2, #474c58); } .ds-scene__tab { padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--card, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(22 24 29 / 0.06); } .ds-scene__gizmo { width: 36px; height: 36px; margin-left: auto; } .ds-scene__view { position: absolute; inset: 40px 0 0 0; overflow: hidden; perspective: 760px; perspective-origin: 50% 0%; } .ds-scene__floor { position: absolute; left: -60%; right: -60%; top: 30%; height: 180%; transform-origin: 50% 0; transform: rotateX(74deg); background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(22 24 29 / 0.16) 1.5px, transparent 1.5px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(22 24 29 / 0.16) 1.5px, transparent 1.5px), linear-gradient(rgb(22 24 29 / 0.09) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(22 24 29 / 0.09) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 240px 240px, 240px 240px, 48px 48px, 48px 48px; background-position: 50% 0; mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 0%, #000 22%, #000 55%, transparent 92%); }

narrative.overview:
The site is laid out like the Unity editor's Scene view seen through a calm, well-lit window: a warm off-white ground under a cool skybox band, white rounded cards that sit on it like inspector panels, and the editor's own spatial vocabulary (perspective grid floor, XYZ axis gizmo, wireframe primitives with camera and light gizmos) as the only decoration. Density is moderate and card-based; every fact lives in a panel with a clear edge, and nothing is ornamental that a Unity user would not recognise from their own workspace.

The palette is near-monochrome ink on warm paper with one ultramarine voice. The three axis colours are borrowed from the gizmo and stay small: world axes, gizmo arrows, category dots. Unfinished content is the one place the system shouts: hazard-yellow tape, deliberately foreign to the palette, so nothing pending can be mistaken for finished work.

Dark mode is the same world in neutral graphite: near-equal RGB, a hair warm, never blue-black slate. Cards rise from the ground by tone and shadow, not by colour.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ground, cool sky gradient at the top of the page, white 16px cards with soft long shadows.
Serif headings (Source Serif 4) over a sans UI and body (Archivo), both self-hosted variable fonts.
One accent (ultramarine) for links, focus, active state and small structural marks.
X red / Y green / Z blue reserved for scene semantics: gizmo, world axes, category marks, the "live" availability dot.
Hazard-yellow TODO system for every pending fact, link, and media slot.
Pills for actions and filters; rounded rectangles for panels and icon buttons.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Ultramarine is the only accent. It marks interaction and structure (links, focus, active, small rules and bullets), never large fills.

rules.name: The Axis Leash Rule
rules.body: Axis red, green and blue carry scene meaning only: gizmo, world axes, category marks, the live dot. They are never used for buttons, headings, or decoration.

rules.name: The Hazard Tape Rule
rules.body: Hazard yellow means "not finished" and nothing else. Every pending fact, link, metric, or media slot wears it; no finished element ever does.

rules.name: The Graphite Rule
rules.body: Dark mode neutrals stay near-equal RGB with a slight warm bias. No blue-black or slate.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks, Sans Works Rule
rules.body: Serif for names, headings and headline numbers; Archivo for everything you read in passing or click.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The uppercase label marks data fields; it is never placed as a kicker above a heading.

rules.name: The Lift On Intent Rule
rules.body: Interactive cards rise 2–3px and take the Lifted shadow on hover; buttons rise 1px. Nothing moves at rest except the scene floor's slow dolly and the live dot, both off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Grid Is The Floor Rule
rules.body: The grid exists only as the perspective ground plane inside a Scene-view panel. The page ground itself carries no grid.

dos: **Do** render every unfinished fact, link, metric and media slot through the hazard-yellow TODO system, and make pending links non-clickable with dashed borders.
**Do** keep ultramarine as the only accent: links, focus, active state, the 44×3px heading rule, 6px bullet squares.
**Do** put content in 16px white cards with hairline borders and the Card shadow; separate sub-sections inside a card with hairlines.
**Do** use Source Serif 4 for headings and headline numbers, Archivo for body and UI.
**Do** use pills (999px) for actions and filters, and dark button-ink fill for the single primary action in a group.
**Do** keep dark mode on warm neutral graphite (#151413 ground, #1d1c1a cards).
donts: **Don't** use axis red, green or blue outside the gizmo, world axes, category dots and the live dot.
**Don't** use hazard yellow for anything that is finished, or as a highlight colour.
**Don't** lay a grid on the page ground; the grid belongs only to the Scene-view floor.
**Don't** use blue-black or slate neutrals in dark mode.
**Don't** place an uppercase label as a kicker above a heading.
**Don't** invent metrics, logos or testimonials to fill a slot; leave the TODO showing.
